name: Big Cube Bash 2017
information:
Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out.
If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please contact us. If it is before registration has closed, you are eligible for a refund for half of your fee.
There are multiple food options nearby where competitors will be able to get food. 
The registration fee will be $25 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 150. Registration will close on May 6th, 2017. Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete. No at-the-door registrations or payments will be accepted. ALL SPECTATORS ARE WELCOME TO ATTEND FOR FREE.
CubeDepot will be vending and supplying prizes for the winners.
